Висмут Соединения Bismuth compounds have been used for their astrin- gent and antidiarrhoeal properties in a variety of gas- trointestinal disorders, and have been applied topically in skin disorders and anorectal disorders such as haem- orrhoids. Certain salts are active against Helicobacter pylori and are used in the treatment of peptic ulcer dis- ease. Bismuth Aluminate (USAN) Aluminato de bismuto; Aluminum Bismuth Oxide.
